settings_preArmHint: Applies until you turn it off. You're always asked when you can win.
settings_noCallsDesc: Pass every pung, kong and chow offer automatically.
settings_autoPassChowDesc: Pass automatically when chow is the only call on offer.
settings_soundEffectsDesc: Sounds aren't in the game yet; this choice is kept for when they are.
settings_hapticsDesc: Vibrate when it's your turn or a claim is offered. Phones only.
settings_motionFullDesc: Always animate, even if your device asks for less motion.
settings_discardModeTwoStepDesc: Tap a tile to lift it, tap it again to discard.
settings_discardModeOneTapDesc: Tap a tile to discard it straight away.
settings_announceAllDiscardsDesc: Read out every discard, not only the ones you can claim.
settings_tileSizeSmallDesc: More room on the table. Your hand never shrinks below a comfortable tap size.
settings_tileSizeLargeDesc: Bigger tiles where the screen has room. Your hand always fits the width.
settings_handOrderAutoDesc: Your hand is always sorted by suit and number.
settings_handOrderManualDesc: Drag tiles to arrange them, or use Shift + ←/→ on a focused tile. New tiles join at the right.
